commentaries.author: parimēlaḻagar
commentaries.text: A ruler should weigh how rare it is, then find the right way to win the friendship of wise men older than himself, who know the fine points of righteousness. Older means mature in knowledge, conduct and years. The wise know sound policy and the ways of the world. The way to win them is to esteem them, raise them up and defer to them.
